payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results related to the use of different models and techniques for cyberbullying detection, including the effects of oversampling and transfer learning.

claims.text: Oversampling the bullying class improved performance across all DNN models, particularly benefiting the smallest dataset, Formspring.
Transfer learning showed low recall but higher precision when using a model trained on one dataset to detect cyberbullying in others, indicating different natures of cyberbullying across datasets.
DNN models outperformed traditional machine learning models (LR, SVM, RF, NB) in cyberbullying detection, as shown in comparative performance results.
